Package com.smu.example.baseline

Interface NodeDao

public interface NodeDao
Data Access Object (DAO) interface representing operations for Merkle Tree Nodes. This interface uses JDBI v3 declarative API to perform CRUD operations against the underlying SQLite table.

Note: Nodes are uniquely identified by a composite primary key consisting of (start, end).

  • Method Details

    • createTable

      void createTable()
      Initializes the database table. Creates the nodes table using SQLite syntax if it does not already exist. The schema includes a composite primary key (start, end, timestamp), certificate index represented, and a hash value.

    • insert

      int insert(MTC_Baseline_Node_Record node)
      Inserts a single Merkle Tree node record into the database.

      Important: The property names of the MTC_Baseline_Node_Record object (via getters) must strictly map to the SQL named parameters (e.g., :timestamp).

      Parameters:
      node - the MTC_Baseline_Node_Record instance containing the node data to be inserted
      Returns:
      the number of rows affected (1 if successful)

    • insertBatch

      void insertBatch(List<MTC_Baseline_Node_Record> nodes)
      Inserts multiple node records in a single batch operation. Uses JDBI's @SqlBatch mechanism for optimized high-throughput batch insertions.
      Parameters:
      nodes - the list of MTC_Baseline_Node_Record instances to insert

    • findByIndex

      MTC_Baseline_Node_Record findByIndex(MTC_Baseline_Index index)
      Retrieves a single node record matching the specified composite primary key.
      Parameters:
      index - the MTC_Baseline_Index instance containing the start and end boundaries
      Returns:
      the matching MTC_Baseline_Node_Record, or null if no match is found

    • findByTimestamp

      List<MTC_Baseline_Node_Record> findByTimestamp(long timestamp)
      Retrieves a list of active (non-expired) nodes at a given point in time. A node is considered active if create_time <= timestamp and either expired_time == -1 or expired_time > timestamp.
      Parameters:
      timestamp - the target epoch timestamp to query against
      Returns:
      a list of active MTC_Baseline_Node_Record instances matching the timestamp criteria

    • findByIndices

      List<MTC_Baseline_Node_Record> findByIndices(List<MTC_Baseline_Index> indices)
      Performs a batch retrieval using a collection of composite primary keys. Utilizes SQLite's Tuple IN syntax (start, end) IN (<indices>) to fetch multiple records efficiently.
      Parameters:
      indices - a list of MTC_Baseline_Index instances representing the lookup targets
      Returns:
      a list of matching MTC_Baseline_Node_Record instances

    • findByCertInd

      MTC_Baseline_Node_Record findByCertInd(int certInd, long timestamp)
      Retrieves a node record by its certificate indicator and timestamp.
      Parameters:
      certInd - the certificate indicator to search for
      timestamp - the timestamp to search for
      Returns:
      the matching MTC_Baseline_Node_Record, or null if no match is found

    • findLeavesByTimestamp

      ArrayList<MTC_Baseline_Node_Record> findLeavesByTimestamp(long timestamp)
      Retrieves all leaf nodes (nodes with a valid certificate index) at a specific timestamp. A leaf node is defined as a node where certInd != -1.
      Parameters:
      timestamp - the timestamp to filter leaf nodes
      Returns:
      a list of MTC_Baseline_Node_Record instances representing the leaf nodes at the given timestamp
